correlated_h2_failure_diagnosis.root_cause_summary: While `agents.defaults.model` in OpenClaw carried `{"primary": "anthropic/claude-opus-4-8", "fallbacks": ["anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6", "openai/gpt-5.5"]}` and `PersonaRuntimeProfile` resolved `fallback_models: ("anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6", "openai/gpt-5.5")`, the Persona opinion `ensure` and agent sync seam wrote only a single string `--model anthropic/claude-opus-4-8` via `openclaw agents add`, dropped `persona_profile` routing in `OpenClawOpsClient.ensure_persona_opinion_agent` and `_sync_persona_opinion_agent`, and did not write `{"primary", "fallbacks"}` into the agent's `agents.list` entry during `_apply_persona_opinion_runtime_policy` or update already-provisioned agents.

changes: Extended `PersonaAgentSpec` with `fallback_models`, `routing_mode`, and `model_policy()` returning `{"primary": self.model, "fallbacks": list(self.fallback_models)}`.
Updated `_runtime_profile_model` and `desired_agent_spec` to normalize route policies and preserve `routing.fallback_models` and `routing.mode` from `build_persona_runtime_profile`.
Updated `_agent_model` and `_agent_fallbacks` to support structured `{"primary", "fallbacks"}` model dicts in `agents.list` as well as string model fields.

Added `_reconcile_agent_model_policy` using `openclaw config get agents.list --json` and `openclaw config set agents.list <json> --strict-json --replace` so both newly created and already-provisioned agents persist `{"primary", "fallbacks"}` and update drifted primary/fallback policies.
Returned `fallback_models`, `model_policy`, and `routing_mode` in the ensured agent projection.

Updated `OpenClawOpsClient.ensure_persona_opinion_agent` to resolve and validate canonical Persona model routing from `admission` and `persona_profile` via `build_persona_runtime_profile`, failing closed with `OPENCLAW_PERSONA_MODEL_ROUTING_INVALID` (HTTP 400) when outside the provider pool.

Propagated canonical `model_routing` in the adapter `/api/openclaw-adapter/agents/persona-opinion/ensure` request body and included the resolved model policy in the deterministic `Idempotency-Key` derivation so already-provisioned agents reconcile their `agents.list` model policy without stale replay collisions.
Accepted and validated optional `model_routing` on `OpenClawPersonaOpinionEnsureRequest` while keeping `_persona_admission_fingerprint` scoped to the 15 frozen admission identity/authority claims.

Updated `_sync_persona_opinion_agent`, `_apply_persona_opinion_runtime_policy`, `_assert_persona_opinion_runtime_policy`, and `_reconcile_persona_opinion_replay` to write and verify `item["model"] = {"primary": spec.model, "fallbacks": list(spec.fallback_models)}` alongside `_PERSONA_OPINION_RUNTIME_POLICY` (`tools`, `skills`, `memorySearch`, `contextInjection`).

delivery_boundary.note: Source repair and unit/contract verification in `ajoe734/pantheon` are distinct from hosted deployment version acceptance (H1) and live hosted 2Persona+1 synthesis execution (H3/H6).
